name: Work type
description: The nature of construction works a permit covers. Distinguishing new build from alteration is what makes permit data usable as a housing-supply indicator rather than only as a compliance record.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Alteration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Internal or external modification without enlargement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Change of use
hasDefinedTerm.description: A change in how a structure is used, without physical works.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Temporary
hasDefinedTerm.description: Works or structures with a limited permitted life.
